name: The Dusk Ceremony — the yard wakes
description: Opening ceremony at dusk. All characters face the road in one yard. Drop a music track at data/audio-library/dusk-theme.mp3 (the music steps skip gracefully if absent).

say.text: The sun stands down. [Romanian accent] The watch stands UP. Hear me, Warner Castle — the night shift begins. [shouts] LA ARME!
[shouts] SUN LEAVING! GOOD! NIGHT PEOPLE COME NOW! GROUNDBREAKER READY! ROOF READY! EVERYTHING READY!
The field wakes... the vines stretch... [laughs] Pumpkinhead smells an evening of EXCELLENT souls. The garden is OPEN.
Dusk! Duly recorded, in triplicate! The registry is OPEN. [whispers] Sign nothing, all of you. You are most welcome.
[whispers] ...the light is going. I can feel it through the wood. Come near, whoever you are... the castle is waking, and I am listening.
[breathes] Night. [Romanian accent] My jurisdiction. [slow] Warner Castle... receives you. Come closer.
